fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: étude expérimentale comparative évaluant l’impact du fine‑tuning d’un petit LLM sur la performance de l’écran de titres et résumés d’une revue systématique
fields.quote: The purpose of this study was to explore how fine-tuning a small LLM can impact its performance during LLM-based screening of titles and abstracts for an individual systematic review.

fields.label: Données
fields.value: 8 694 études, titres et résumés, domaine de l'éducation en informatique de premier cycle, influence des technologies d'IA générative.
fields.quote: The dataset consisted of the titles and abstracts from 8,694 studies that were located as part of a systematic review on the influence of generative artificial intelligence technologies in undergraduate computer science education.

fields.label: Modèles
fields.value: Fine-tuning d'un LLM de 1,2 milliard de paramètres pour le dépistage d'études systématiques.
fields.quote: We fine-tune a small 1.2 billion parameter open-weight LLM specifically for study screening in the context of a systematic review in which humans rated more than 8500 titles and abstracts for potential inclusion.

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: 80.79% d'exactitude globale, 99.96% de précision, 86.38% de rappel et 92.67% de F1 pour la classe Exclude.
fields.quote: 80.79%. Per-class results show that the majority class dominates aggregate performance Exclude class, which achieves 99.96% precision, 86.38% recall, and 92.67% F1 (Table 4).

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Limite liée au choix du modèle LLM à fine-tuner.
fields.quote: The selection of which LLM to fine-tune is not a trivial task.
